title: Cosmic Demon Tamer
description: A woman in a sleek black futuristic bodysuit with glowing blue lines stands centrally with arms outstretched on a reflective alien surface. She is surrounded by four large floating demonic bull-like heads with glowing red eyes, while numerous smaller pink demonic creatures hang upside down from an overhead metallic structure against a vibrant cosmic sky featuring aurora, stars, and a black hole.
prompt: A powerful woman in a black futuristic bodysuit with glowing blue circuit lines stands with arms outstretched on a reflective alien shore. She commands four large floating demonic bull heads with glowing red eyes. Numerous smaller pink demonic creatures hang upside down from a massive overhead metallic bridge. Dramatic cosmic background with swirling aurora borealis, stars, a distant black hole with accretion disk, and small sailboat on the horizon, in a highly detailed surreal fantasy style.
